company.description:
Rwaq is a Saudi education Startup works with top universities and organisations Academics instructors to present Massive Open Online Courses for the Arab World. 

We offers Free High Quality Academic Courses for the Arab World. A fun, easy to use, and usable E-learning platform for the masses.
